provenance.name: anchored-v6.owner-capsule
provenance.note: The anchored set anchored-v6 (docs/calibration/anchoring.md) with the owner's capsule laid over it: the composition of detergents/finish-powerball-ultimate.json (Finish Powerball Ultimate, desk research, nothing measured: docs/research/detergent-finish-ultimate.md) and the protease level of a premium unit dose (liq.xProtease = 0.03; estimated from the active protease of a premium unit dose in its maker's patents, not this product's). Wash with a dose of 12.9 g (dosing.detergentMass, a machine value). Calibrated on the owner's own machine (docs/calibration/owner-wash-01-calibration.md; wash record owner-wash-01-egg-yolk-eco50, one wash of four plates): prog.soakDuty = 0.8, held in the anchored set this layer is laid over. The protease is as stable as the registry says (liq.proteaseHalfLife 30 min at 60 C and pH 10.5, 1.7 times as long at the capsule's pH 10.1). No measurement of the capsule's protease exists: this is the lower end of a bracket whose upper end is the set with the suffix "stable".

supersededBy.why: fitted on the machine as it was drawn before the upper basket was corrected and on the standard loads settled on that basket; fitted again on the corrected machine (docs/calibration/anchoring-v7.md)
